entries.claim: RG115a supplies the Father-directed Per Dominum ending w026–w046 and Amen w047. Its literal rubric formula is unaccented. Same-edition p.123 controls matching accented formula words, and p.226 controls the accented four-word terminal and separately marked Amen period. These controls do not make the proper page a full-ending witness or establish response actors, singing, or larger-group conclusion distribution.
